name: CHAI PPM grant BOTEC, 2024
summary: GiveWell's spreadsheet "CHAI PPM grant BOTEC, 2024", linked from its grant page. Every number is traced from the sheet's bottom line; calculated rows reproduce the sheet's own values.

resources.title: GiveWell grant page (clinton health access initiative chai program performance management grant october 2024)

rows.label: Total increase in value from improvement in programs influenced by PPM team (Best guess)
rows.explainer:
Calculated in the source sheet as `=(PV(B18,B9,-B17,,1))*(1-B19)`; kept as a fixed number here (text in arithmetic).

Calculation. This accounts for a 4% discount rate and the probabiity of failure.

rows.label: Grant size ($ million) (Best guess)
rows.explainer:
CHAI, Organizational Development Budget (unpublished) From the budget CHAI provided us, they expect to spend $1.3 million annually on the Program performance management team and $0.4 million annually on Talent and enabling infrastructure. We are funding these activities for three years. 

$1.3 million + $0.4 million = $1.7 million * 3 years = $5.1 million.

rows.label: Units of value per dollar, GiveDirectly (Best guess)
Units of value per dollar given to GiveDirectly
rows.explainer: GiveWell reports this model's result in multiples of cash transfers. Multiplying by GiveWell's value of a dollar to GiveDirectly converts it into units of value per dollar, so it ranks against the other models. Older sheets used older moral weights; the multiple of cash is the comparable number across years.
